name: galaxz-led-walker
status: TESTING (a test build: install, write down the map, then flash Galax-z v1 or the original back)
description: Lights one LED at a time so the LED index -> key map can be written down. While installed the keys show only the walk. See notes/leds.md and walker/led_walker.S.

edits.what: the UI frame's LED send calls the walker first (which then jumps on to the send)
edits.evidence: [code] 'CALL 0x8003d620' at 0x8010a9de is the only LED send of the UI frame (every path of 0x8010a904 ends there); 'CALL 0x80c00000' has the same size; notes/leds.md

revert: Flash Galax-z v1 or the original (Firmware/flash, or the Galax-z hub on the Mac).
risk: First code of ours on the unit. If 0x80C00000 is not free after all, the OS crashes or the LEDs misbehave: switch off, update mode, flash the original.
